why: Both land on the key's hedgehog (paper-based consumer products, profit per consumer brand), but Analysis 2 commits outright to selling the commodity mills, namesake included, and to fighting Rival P head-on, and it lists 'the mills cannot be best in the world' as a brutal fact.
